queries.query: select case when total_llevar is null then 0 else total_llevar end as total_llevar from( select sum(ll.valor_total) as total_llevar from llevar ll where ll.fecha_orden between :fechaInicial and :fechaFinal and ll.estado_orden='A' )sub

SELECT CASE WHEN sub2.valor_total is null THEN 0 ELSE sub2.valor_total END AS valor_total, CASE WHEN sub2.valor_porcentaje is null THEN 0 ELSE sub2.valor_porcentaje END AS valor_porcentaje FROM ( SELECT sub1.valor_total,sub1.valor_porcentaje FROM ( SELECT SUM(sub0.valor_total) as valor_total, SUM(sub0.valor_porcentaje) as valor_porcentaje FROM( SELECT l.id_dian,l.valor_total,CASE WHEN l.id_dian = 0 or l.id_dian is null THEN 0 ELSE l.valor_total END valor_porcentaje FROM llevar l WHERE l.fecha_orden BETWEEN :fechaInicial and :fechaFinal and l.estado_orden='A' )sub0 )sub1 )sub2
